standard.summary: 分别设置 Anima 各注意力类型（cross-attn / self-attn / mlp / modulation）的独立学习率，实现细粒度的学习率差异化控制。
standard.effect: 允许对不同功能的模块使用不同学习率：cross-attn 控制文本-图像对齐（通常需要更高 LR）；self-attn 控制图像内部结构（适当 LR）；MLP 控制局部变换（通常可以低 LR）。
standard.whenToUse: 有明确的训练目标（如只改文本响应 → 提高 cross-attn LR，降低 self-attn 和 MLP LR）时使用。高级调参场景。
standard.avoidWhen: 初学或不确定各模块分工时，保持各部分 LR 相同（或只设 global learning_rate）更安全。

standard_en.summary: Sets a separate learning rate for each Anima attention type (cross-attn / self-attn / mlp / modulation), for fine-grained differentiated control.
standard_en.effect: Lets modules with different jobs use different rates: cross-attn governs text-image alignment and usually wants a higher LR; self-attn governs internal image structure and wants a moderate one; MLP governs local transforms and can usually take a low LR.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you have an explicit goal -- for instance changing only the text response, so raise the cross-attn LR and lower the self-attn and MLP ones. An advanced tuning scenario.
standard_en.avoidWhen: If you are new to this or unsure what each module does, keeping the rates equal, or setting only the global learning_rate, is safer.

advanced.principle: Anima 的 DiT block 分为几类参数组：cross-attn（文本条件输入）/ self-attn（图像自注意力）/ MLP（前馈网络）/ modulation（时间步条件调制），各自对训练的不同方面有独立影响。分别设置 LR 等价于 block weight 的 LR 版本。
advanced.tradeoffs: 差异化 LR 需要对模型行为有深入理解；设置不当可能导致某部分过训练（如 cross-attn LR 过高导致文本绑定过强，生成失去灵活性）。

advanced_en.principle: Anima's DiT blocks split into several parameter groups: cross-attn (text conditioning input) / self-attn (image self-attention) / MLP (feed-forward) / modulation (timestep conditioning modulation), each independently influencing a different aspect of training. Setting LRs separately is the LR version of block weights.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Differentiated LRs require deep understanding of model behavior; a poor setting can over-train one part (e.g. cross-attn LR too high over-binds text, sapping generation flexibility).
